headline: An entertainment company needed a business structure as ambitious as its creative vision.
challenge: Entertainment ventures move between productions, talent and partners — without a proper corporate structure, growth gets informally managed until something breaks.
delivered: Business consultancy on production and partnership structuring
Administrative support for contracts and statutory records
Advisory on regulatory obligations for media and entertainment activity
impact: An entertainment company with the corporate structure to formalise partnerships, protect its productions, and present itself credibly to investors and collaborators.
